title: Changing the Display Language for Zscaler Client Connector in the Classic UI

blocks.text: This article provides information about the Classic UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector versions earlier than 5.0. To learn more about the Modern UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0, see Using Zscaler Client Connector in the Modern UI.
If your organization has enabled the option, you can change the language in which the Zscaler Client Connector app displays.
This feature is available only with Zscaler Client Connector version 4.8 and later for Windows. The default language is based on the app profile.

blocks.item: Open Zscaler Client Connector and click More.
The app UI and pop-up notifications change to the language you selected.
